message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on Chinese law. Facts: Using illegal fishing gear (minimum mesh size 9mm, prohibited) in a prohibited fishing area (禁渔区) with an unregistered vessel (三无船舶). Captured 12,250 kg fish, illegal profit 10,500 RMB. Caught by authorities. Likely crimes: "非法捕捞水产资源罪" (illegal fishing) under Criminal Law article 338? Actually article 338 of PRC Criminal Law: "非法捕捞水产资源罪" for using prohibited gear, in protected areas, etc. Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But main is illegal fishing. Also "走私、非法买卖、运输、携带、收购、使用、制造、提供伪造、变造的渔业专用证件罪"? Not here. Also "非法捕捞水产资源罪" may have sub-article for using prohibited gear. Also "非法捕捞水产资源罪" can be combined with "非法捕捞水产资源罪" and "非法捕捞水产资源罪" only one. Could also be "非法捕捞水产资源罪" and "非法捕捞水产资源罪"? No.

Maybe also "非法捕捞水产资源罪" and "非法捕捞水产资源罪"? Not.

Could be "非法捕捞水产资源罪" and "非法捕捞水产资源罪"? That's nonsense.

Check Chinese criminal law: Article 338: "非法捕捞水产资源罪" - illegal fishing in protected areas, using prohibited gear, etc. Penalty: up to 3 years imprisonment or criminal detention, and fine. If circumstances are especially serious, up to 7 years.

Also "非法捕捞水产资源罪" can be combined with "非法捕捞水产资源罪"? No.

Thus answer: single crime: illegal fishing. Chinese term: "非法捕捞水产资源罪". Provide format: [罪名]非法捕捞水产资源罪<eoa>
